content:
If you want the same LED strip position as with C1+ non-INDX variant has, without printing any holders, now would be a good time to install the strip to the back side of the gantry (behind the screw holes where the green arrows are pointing). 

How to (A and B):
A: See first comment in the 89.
B (how I did it):
Avoid touching LEDs and resistors
1. Remove the LED panel.
2. Slowly and carefully remove the LED strip from the LED panel, avoid over 90° angles when removing the strip, it should come off quite easily.
3. Reinsert the strip to the new location shown in the first picture with green arrows. 
4. LED strip should be fully hidden when viewing from the front.

INDX tools only slightly limit the lights, but added bonus is that you are able to see the nozzles much better if they are dirty or have any markings on them after printing.
